comment: Where to point the leak scan at a dataset this project did not write, and which of its fields are which. Nothing of that dataset is copied here: it is Apache-2.0 and this repository is MIT, so the map names a commit and a path and the reader supplies the checkout. Set EHS_MANTIS_SNAPSHOT to a checkout of the commit below and the gate reports what it found; leave it unset and the gate says the measurement was not taken, which is not the same as saying it was clean.
name: google/mantis reference/evals/patch_dataset.json
how_to_get_it: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/google/mantis.git /tmp/mantis && EHS_MANTIS_SNAPSHOT=/tmp/mantis bash scripts/gates/gate-triage-stage.sh
